verdict.rationale: Supabase offers multiple concrete sandbox paths for AI-native testing: local dev stack via CLI (supabase init/start), self-hosting for full isolation, and database branching that explicitly creates isolated preview environments per PR/change 'without affecting your production setup,' plus MCP read_only and project_ref scoping to avoid touching prod data. Hands-on probes confirm headless local provisioning works. missing for 10: independent third-party verification that branching/local dev fully mirrors prod fidelity for AI agent testing, and no explicit hands-on evidence of an agent running tests against a branch/local sandbox end-to-end.
